# Just 4 kiDDS Dentistry for Children

> A pediatric dental practice in Idaho Falls and Pocatello specializing in child-friendly dental care with a mission to help kids love the dentist.

Just 4 kiDDS Dentistry for Children operates two locations in Idaho serving families with comprehensive pediatric dental services. The practice is led by Dr. Jordan Higham, Dr. Austin French, and Dr. Oliver Swensen, offering preventive care, treatments, and emergency services designed specifically for children.
